items.q: Do I need to know anything about blockchain?
items.a: No. Nobody does, not you, not your students, not the person checking. You'll see email, links and a dashboard. The heavy cryptography stays where it belongs: out of sight.
Your credentials keep working. They're built on open standards, so they can be exported and verified without us. We think that's the only honest way to build this.

items.q: Can my recipients mess it up?
items.a: There's nothing to mess up. They get an email with a link. That's the whole experience, no wallet, no password, no app to install.
In normal, GDPR-compliant storage that can be edited or deleted, never on anything public or permanent. Only tamper-proof fingerprints are anchored publicly.
Issuing is priced so any institution can afford it; heavy verification is billed per check. Design partners get generous early terms, that could be you.

pricing.title: Pricing
pricing.subtitle: Verifiers pay for verifications. Issuing credentials is always free. No wallet, no per-seat fees, no lock-in.
pricing.featureCore: Verification by ID, link or credential file
pricing.footnote: Every plan includes the independent trust mark, the public verification page and the full API. Overage on paid plans is billed monthly at the per-verification rate above.

faq.a1: One check of one credential: by hash, by verifiable credential, by zkTLS proof, or by uploaded certificate image. Issuing credentials never counts, and re-checking a credential you already verified in the same billing period is free.
faq.q2: What happens when I pass my included verifications?
faq.a2: On Free, verification is capped: further calls are blocked until the next period, so you are never charged by surprise. On Starter and Scale, extra verifications are billed monthly at the per-verification rate on the plan.
faq.a3: Yes. Anyone can issue credentials, design templates and share the public credential page at no cost. Only the verifier side, the relying parties consuming the API, pays.
faq.q4: Do my recipients need a wallet or an account?
faq.a4: No. A credential is a link. Recipients open it, share it and add it to LinkedIn without installing anything, and verifiers confirm it with one API call.
faq.a5: Any time, from your workspace. Upgrades apply immediately; the included quota and the per-verification rate change with the plan.
